integrity: The general argument uses elementary quadratic congruence lifting; exact integer enumeration checks p=5,7,11,13,17 only and is not used as proof for arbitrary primes. No computational, literature, or audit result is represented as independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Prime p≥5 and modulus p² only; constant-input fourth moment, no unrestricted sharp operator norm; originality best-knowledge and independent audit not performed.
title: Complete twofold-sum spectrum of the cubic graph over prime-square rings
